tells.1: Generic lifestyle imagery—an afternoon baking, a quiet cup of tea, the last crumb—substitutes for useful product detail.
tells.3: Stacked fragments and balanced slogans, especially “A little measuring done. A little joy delivered.” and “Less measuring. More making.”

reason: Version 2 gives readers concrete reasons to trust and want the product, provided its factual claims are accurate. Version 1 is clear but repetitive; version 3 adds conspicuous rhythm without adding substance.
